Archive Payload As JSON.description: Stores the incoming payload (e.g. a form submission) as a JSON object in S3 for backup or audit.

Upload CSV Export.description: Writes rows as a CSV file to S3, e.g. a daily beneficiary or payment list for a partner to pick up.

Upload Encrypted File.description: Uploads a file with server-side encryption, for sensitive health or registry data.

Archive Each Record Separately.description: Writes one S3 object per record in a batch.

List Files In Folder.description: Lists the objects under a key prefix (folder) in a bucket.

Find New Files Since Last Run.description: Lists files in a drop folder and keeps only those modified since the last run.

Read JSON File.description: Downloads a JSON object from S3; it is parsed into state automatically.

Download Binary File.description: Downloads a non-JSON file (CSV, PDF, image); the content comes back base64-encoded.
